# Guangzhou Qijiang Technology Co., Ltd.

Official company website: https://qijiang-arcade.pages.dev/

Guangzhou Qijiang Technology Co., Ltd. supplies commercial arcade and amusement equipment from Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

Product scope:

- Basketball, boxing, strength, football and target arcade machines
